newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF says committed to WTO financial talks.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF says committed to WTO financial talks.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told the director-general of the World Trade Organisation (WTO), Renato Ruggiero, on Friday that Tokyo is committed to helping to reach a successful conclusion to the WTO's financial services talks, a ministry official said.
"We want to help achieve a successful conclusion to the financial services negotiations," Mitsuzuka was quoted as saying by the Ministry of Finance (MOF) official.

Ruggiero, who is on a visit to Japan to meet government officials and business leaders, stressed the importance of reaching an accord on liberalising financial services and expressed gratitude over Japan's cooperation with the WTO so far, the official said.
Mitsuzuka told Ruggiero about Japan's "Big Bang" financial reforms, pointing out that Japan will also make efforts to liberalise its financial markets.
Ruggiero was quoted as saying that he was watching Japan's financial reforms with great interest.
